adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, the code calls `open(url).read` immediately (no scheme validation there) and only later calls `TopicEmbed.import`, which is where the `^https?://` check exists. Separately, `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` validates only `URI(@embed_url).host` against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, and `URI("//eviltrout.com/x").host` is `"eviltrout.com"`, so a schemeless URL can pass host validation and reach `open(url)`. That means `open("//eviltrout.com/x")` will be treated as a local path by `Kernel#open` unless `open-uri` handling is guaranteed, matching the finding’s concern.
